address_missing: Set the IP address of your Toon in the device settings.

error.timeout: The Toon did not answer in time. Check that it is switched on and connected to your network, then try again.
error.network: Homey cannot reach the Toon. Check the IP address and that the Toon is switched on and connected to your network.
error.http: The Toon answered with an error (code __status__). Check that the address belongs to your Toon and try again later.
error.bad_body: The Toon sent an answer that this app cannot read. Check that the address belongs to a Toon with the open software and try again.
error.toon_error: The Toon refused the request. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, restart the Toon.
error.aborted: The request was cancelled because the device was removed or its address changed.
error.address_https: The Toon speaks plain http. Remove https:// from the address.
error.address_ipv6: IPv6 addresses are not supported. Use the IPv4 address of the Toon, for example 192.168.1.50.
error.address_invalid: This is not a valid address. Enter the IPv4 address of your Toon, for example 192.168.1.50.
error.invalid_value: The request was not sent because a value is not valid. Check the values in your Flow and the IP address of the Toon.
error.interval_invalid: The update interval must be a number of seconds from 10 to 3600.
error.not_toon: This does not look like an open Toon. Check the address and that your Toon runs the open software.
error.vacation_readonly: Vacation mode can only be set on the Toon itself.
error.unknown: Something went wrong while talking to the Toon. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the IP address and your network.

toonwater.status_sensor_module: Unexpected response: this looks like the address of the ToonWater sensor module, not of the Toon
toonwater.saved_off: ToonWater turned off. The water items were removed; Flows that used them need to be updated and their Insights history may be lost.
toonwater.saved_detected: ToonWater found. Water values will appear shortly.
toonwater.saved_not_found: ToonWater was not found on this Toon. The water items were added but stay empty until the add-on is installed and running.
toonwater.saved_unreachable: The Toon could not be reached, so ToonWater could not be checked. The water items were added; they fill in as soon as the Toon answers.
toonwater.saved_unexpected: The Toon answered, but not the way ToonWater does. The water items were added; check that the add-on is installed and running.
toonwater.saved_sensor_module: This address answers like the ToonWater sensor module, not like the Toon. The water items were added but stay empty; use the IP address of the Toon itself.
toonwater.warning_not_found: ToonWater is enabled but was not found on this Toon
toonwater.hint_not_found: ToonWater is switched on for __name__, but it has not been found on this Toon for 24 hours. If you do not use ToonWater, switch it off in the settings of this device.
toonwater.not_enabled: ToonWater is not enabled for this device

pair.title: Add a Toon
pair.intro: Enter the IP address of your Toon, then test the connection.
pair.id_hint: A short name that is different for every Toon, for example its hostname. It cannot be changed later.
pair.name: Name
pair.name_hint: How the device is called in Homey. Leave empty to use the Toon id.
pair.toonwater_detected: ToonWater was found on this Toon. Tick the box to add the water items to this device now. You can also switch it on later in the device settings.
pair.address_required: Enter the IP address of your Toon.
pair.id_required: Enter an id for this Toon, for example its hostname.
pair.id_taken: A Toon with this id has already been added. Choose another id.
pair.invalid_input: The pairing screen sent something this app cannot use. Close the screen and start again.
pair.create_failed: The device could not be added: __error__
